newsitem.title: UK: Analyst Gifford forms independent consultancy.
newsitem.headline: Analyst Gifford forms independent consultancy.

text.p: Technical analyst Elli Gifford said on Friday she had left Investment Research of Cambridge (IRC) after more than 20 years with the company to form an independent consultancy providing financial market analysis.
Gifford, who was a director at IRC, said she had worked there in three separate stints. Before the last one, she was a director at Rudolf Wolff.
" I will still be working from Cambridge, covering all the futures markets and currencies," Gifford told Reuters.
